reader.requirement: At 1985 the WRITE operand record-name-1 must be the name of a logical record of a file description entry in the File Section, qualified where needed and with no reference modification; a working-storage item, a subordinate item, an ambiguous name, a file-name and an SD record are refused, and the 2002 FILE file-name-1 alternative does not exist.

edition-consulted.switches: GateFilePhrase: WRITE FILE file-name-1 refused below 2002 (COBOL0900); GateRetryLockPlace for the lock phrases

reader.edition-search: grep of SequentialIoBinder.cs and StatementValidation.cs for DialectLevel/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/Permissive: the record-name identity test consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the FILE file-name-1 alternative is refused at 85 and accepted from 2002; the record-name-1 rule itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers a qualified record-name of a sequential FD at 85; refusals, two FDs sharing a record-name, a variable-length file and a relative file are not exercised

probes.printed: A=AAA B=BBB / V LEN=02 [SS] / V LEN=04 [3X] / R=RRRR (EXPECT: MATCH)
probes.expected: REC OF FA and REC IN FB (qualified, same name in two FDs), both records of a RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON file (one with OCCURS DEPENDING ON), and RREC OF FR (relative) are each accepted and written

probes.printed: COBOL1757 WREC not a logical record; COBOL1757 KEYF subordinate to REC; COBOL1757 reference-modified record; COBOL1639 REC ambiguous; COBOL0900 WRITE FILE requires 2002; COBOL1692 SD file SF; COBOL1639 FA is a file-name
probes.expected: each operand that is not a File Section logical record name is refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR2  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: ResolveRecordName is the one identity test for WRITE/REWRITE/RELEASE and runs before the sequential/keyed reroute, so every organization is covered. Cosmetic: the COBOL1757 message prints the operand from rn.GetText(), so KEYF OF REC OF FA reads KEYFOFRECOFFA (DataBinder.WrittenText would keep the spaces); not a rule failure.

refuter.evidence: r5c.cob (r5c-002): a contained program writes GREC OF FG, the record of the containing program's GLOBAL FD, and the outer writes the record of an EXTERNAL FD: both accepted and the records read back G=GGGG E=EEEE. r5b.cob: a contained program's WRITE of the container's non-global record LREC refused COBOL1639 (not visible); 66 RENAMES of the 01 refused. The reader's w2b covers WS item, subordinate item, ref-mod, ambiguous name, SD record, file-name and WRITE FILE (2002) refusals. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR2.
